index.title: Homepage
index.content:
About Me
Hi everyone! I’m Ivan Diliso a Ph.D student from Bari, Italy 🇮🇹.





Research
My current research is focused on neurosymbolic learning for knowledge graphs, ontologies, description logics and their domain-specific application in the railway engeneering. Specifically I’m studying how to inject background knowledge in knowledge graph embedding models, with the parallel task of evaluating the capabilities of the model to represent the learned semantics. In the past I have worked on computer vision for image classification and adversarial attacks, genetic optimization and quantum computing focusing in hybrid model for contrastive learning and clustering.

projects.title: projects
projects.content:
Open-Source Projects
JediKG
Dataset extraction framework for neurosymbolic learning.
Features:

Knowledge graph sampling
Schema modularization
Ontology reasoning
Benchmark generation

GitHub: github.com/ara-t3/jedikg

PyKEEN-NS
Schema-aware negative sampling extension for PyKEEN.
Features:

Static negative sampling
Dynamic negative sampling
Reproducible experimentation
Ontology-guided corruption strategies

GitHub: github.com/ara-t3/pykeen-negative-sampling

TriQlet
Quantum metric learning framework built with PyTorch and Qiskit.
Features:

Quantum Siamese Networks
Modular ansatz design
Quantum embedding layers
Hybrid quantum-classical learning

GitHub: github.com/ivandiliso/triqlet
